routeReconstruction.method: Recovered deterministic exact-five successful traces from the existing Stage 2 cache seeds; no evolution search or new candidate generation.
routeReconstruction.safetyNote: The ledger SOLVED flag alone is not trusted because the historical repair replay skipped PAIR legality checks; every recovered trace is replayed with applyGameMove.

rationale: Hardness and playability are separate scores; no legacy MASTER absolute threshold is reused.
Hardness combines D2, row-clear, proximity, reserve-add, and early-add resistance, then near-miss and successful ADD depth.
Playability requires a RULE 2.1.0 exact-five winning route, measurable AI success, non-extreme ADD behavior, near misses, and an outlier guard.
Selection quality weights hardness 65% and playability 35%; diversity is then added by deterministic max-min greedy selection.

diversity.relaxationNote: The global minimum Hamming target was explicitly relaxed from 4 to 3, then the root-lineage cap from 500 to 650 because the source Stage 2 pool is concentrated in two of five roots. Hamming 3, unique canonical patterns, unique actual solution prefixes, and the legal-pair-structure cap remain enforced.
